preconditions.description: Number of positions is between 1 and 60,000.
Number of die faces is between 4 and 100,000.
Number of turns is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f_i <= n for f_i in f)
preconditions.description: Each field transition value is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p_j < M for p_j in p)
preconditions.description: Each die face probability is between 0 and M-1.
Sum of die face probabilities modulo M is 1.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) < M for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each line in output is an integer between 0 and M-1.

postconditions.expression: sum(int(line) for line in stdout_lines) % M == 1
postconditions.description: Sum of all output probabilities modulo M is 1.
